mapper.select: SELECT p.routing_node_id AS routingNodeId, COALESCE(SUM(r.quantity_delta), 0) AS reportedQty FROM mes_execution_path_node p LEFT JOIN mes_production_report r ON r.execution_id = p.execution_id AND r.routing_node_id = p.routing_node_id WHERE p.execution_id = #{executionId} GROUP BY p.routing_node_id

SELECT r.id AS reportId, r.quantity_delta + COALESCE(SUM(a.quantity_delta), 0) AS effectiveQty FROM mes_production_execution e JOIN mes_production_report r ON r.execution_id = e.id LEFT JOIN mes_production_report a ON a.reference_report_id = r.id AND a.execution_id = e.id AND a.routing_node_id = r.routing_node_id WHERE e.id = #{executionId} AND r.id = #{reportId} GROUP BY r.id, r.quantity_delta

SELECT e.id AS executionId,e.workorder_id AS workorderId,e.execution_no AS executionNo,e.routing_id AS routingId, e.target_qty AS targetQty,p.path_status AS pathStatus,COALESCE(SUM(r.quantity_delta),0) AS lastNodeReportedQty, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(f.output_qty) FROM mes_material_issue_input f JOIN mes_material_issue i ON i.id=f.issue_id AND i.execution_id=f.execution_id JOIN mes_material_issue_submission a ON a.id=i.submission_id AND a.issue_id=i.id AND a.status=#{inputSUCCEEDED} JOIN mes_material_issue_erp_extra x ON x.id=i.id WHERE f.execution_id=e.id AND f.input_kind='PRODUCTION_INPUT' AND f.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND i.status=#{inputCONFIRMED} AND ((f.source_mode=#{inputLOCAL_ONLY} AND x.source_execution_mode=#{inputLOCAL_ONLY} AND x.external_effect=#{inputNONE}) OR (f.source_mode=#{inputCONNECTED} AND x.source_execution_mode=#{inputCONNECTED} AND x.external_effect=#{inputCONFIRMED} AND x.document_status=#{inputEFFECTIVE}))),0) AS productionInputQty FROM mes_production_execution e LEFT JOIN mes_execution_path p ON p.id=e.id LEFT JOIN mes_execution_path_node n ON n.execution_id=e.id AND n.sequence_no=(SELECT MAX(last.sequence_no) FROM mes_execution_path_node last WHERE last.execution_id=e.id) LEFT JOIN mes_production_report r ON r.execution_id=e.id AND r.routing_node_id=n.routing_node_id WHERE e.workorder_id=#{workorderId} GROUP BY e.id,e.workorder_id,e.execution_no,e.routing_id,e.target_qty,p.path_status ORDER BY e.id DESC
mapper.sql: FROM mes_material_issue_input f JOIN mes_material_issue i ON i.id=f.issue_id AND i.execution_id=f.execution_id JOIN mes_material_issue_submission a ON a.id=i.submission_id AND a.issue_id=i.id AND a.status= #{inputSUCCEEDED} JOIN mes_material_issue_erp_extra x ON x . id = i . id WHERE f . input_kind = 'PRODUCTION_INPUT' AND f . confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND i . status IN ( #{inputCONFIRMED}, #{inputVOID_PENDING}, #{inputVOID_UNKNOWN} ) AND ( ( f . source_mode = #{inputLOCAL_ONLY} AND x . source_execution_mode = #{inputLOCAL_ONLY} AND x . external_effect = #{inputNONE} ) OR ( f . source_mode = #{inputCONNECTED} AND x . source_execution_mode = #{inputCONNECTED} AND x . external_effect = #{inputCONFIRMED} AND x . document_status = #{inputEFFECTIVE} ) )

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(f.output_qty),0) AS confirmedQty, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.status IN (#{inputVOID_PENDING},#{inputVOID_UNKNOWN}) THEN f.output_qty ELSE 0 END),0) AS reservedQty
AND f.execution_id=#{executionId}

SELECT f.execution_id executionId,COALESCE(SUM(f.output_qty),0) AS confirmedQty, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.status IN (#{inputVOID_PENDING},#{inputVOID_UNKNOWN}) THEN f.output_qty ELSE 0 END),0) AS reservedQty
AND f.execution_id IN #{id} GROUP BY f.execution_id

SELECT p.execution_id executionId,p.routing_node_id routingNodeId,COALESCE(SUM(r.quantity_delta),0) reportedQty FROM mes_execution_path_node p LEFT JOIN mes_production_report r ON r.execution_id=p.execution_id AND r.routing_node_id=p.routing_node_id WHERE p.execution_id IN #{id} GROUP BY p.execution_id,p.routing_node_id
